legal.intro: Under the Consumer Rights Act you have the right to withdraw from a distance contract.
legal.window_body: You may withdraw from the contract within 14 days of purchasing the voucher, without giving any reason, provided the service has not yet been performed.
legal.consent_body: If you consented to immediate service execution before the 14-day period, your right of withdrawal expires when the service is performed. Giving such consent is voluntary.
legal.post_execution_body: Once the service has been performed following your prior consent, the right of withdrawal no longer applies. The voucher state changes to withdrawal-blocked-after-execution.
legal.refund_body: If you successfully exercise your right of withdrawal, we will reimburse all payments received from you without delay and no later than 14 days after we are informed of your decision. We will use the same payment method you used.
legal.support_body: If we cannot automatically determine the state of your order, we will route you to customer support. Our team will clarify the situation and propose a solution. This support-review state protects your rights and prevents automated errors.
legal.five_states_intro: Each voucher can be in one of five states relating to the right of withdrawal:

state_list.eligible: withdrawal-eligible-before-service-execution — service not performed, withdrawal right active
state_list.consent: consent-to-execute-captured — consent to immediate execution given
state_list.blocked: withdrawal-blocked-after-execution — service performed, withdrawal not available

legal.page_description: Information on the right of withdrawal, voucher fulfilment and how to contact BonBeauty support.

dashboard.intro: Check vouchers, order history, saved inspirations and messages without moving between separate shells.
dashboard.heroAsideBody: If the salon or operator needs your decision, you will see it right away in orders or messages.

vouchers.title: Voucher history
vouchers.intro: Filter active, redeemed and expired vouchers while keeping codes, validity and salon contact in one calm overview.
vouchers.heroAsideBody: Code, salon, product and state stay visible in one place, without exposing the full code on the list.
vouchers.quickActionActive: Ready to use without extra steps.
vouchers.quickActionRedeemed: History of completed services and gifts.
vouchers.quickActionExpired: Codes that need a new decision.

orders.title: Order history
orders.intro: See orders in a list with clear status, date and a route into the operational detail view.
orders.heroAsideTitle: One list for every next step
orders.heroAsideBody: Orders, returns and messages stay connected without mixing in write-heavy settings.
orders.quickActionOpenDescription: Orders waiting for the next step.

orderDetail.title: Order {displayId}
orderDetail.intro: One view for items, delivery, payment summary, timeline and safe handoffs into next actions.
orderDetail.heroAsideBody: Unavailable actions do not disappear. We explain what is possible now and what happens on the salon or operator side.
orderDetail.quickActionVoucher: Resend the voucher or open a download link.
orderDetail.quickActionReturn: Return takes you into dedicated history.
orderDetail.quickActionContact: Safe salon contact without searching in other views.

actionExplainers.resendVoucher: If the recipient needs access again, the same order context is preserved.
actionExplainers.invoice: The document stays connected to this order and its state.
actionExplainers.return: If return is not available, we explain it calmly instead of hiding the action.
actionExplainers.contact: The conversation stays focused on this order and its fulfillment.

trust.forUsLabel: What is next for the salon:
trust.forYouBody: Check messages or use one of the actions when you are ready.
trust.forUsBody: We confirm fulfillment, keep documents in order and maintain clear communication.

returns.title: Return history
returns.intro: The return list shows state, date and reason without masking access or configuration failures.
returns.heroAsideBody: This surface stays read-only. If a process needs action, we guide to the correct path instead of mixing flows.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.intro: See saved products and personally named collections without switching into settings or heavier edit flows.
wishlist.heroAsideBody: The read-heavy view shows the collection name and short context, without turning wishlist into a settings screen.
wishlist.quickActionVouchersDescription: Back to codes ready to use.
wishlist.quickActionOrdersDescription: Purchase history next to saved items.

messages.title: Buyer-salon messages
messages.intro: The inbox keeps a calm communication tone and shows only what is needed to operate the order journey.
messages.heroAsideBody: When the local messaging provider is not ready, we render a safe read model without access to production secrets.
messages.quickActionOrdersDescription: Jump to the orders behind each thread.

quick_actions.orders_desc: Return to order history and track next steps.
quick_actions.reviews_desc: Finish pending reviews without leaving Account Hub.
quick_actions.return_request_desc: Review the return request you just sent.

hero.title: Start a return request without losing context.
hero.description: Choose the reason, attach photos and leave a note for the salon. Validation runs on the client and server before the request is sent.

progress.title: 3-step return flow
progress.description: Progress stays visible while preserving keyboard order.

form.title: Return request form
form.description: All fields follow UX-DR23: blur feedback, localized errors and pending-state protection against duplicate submits.
form.reason_label: Why are you returning this order?
form.photos_help: Add up to 3 JPG, PNG or WEBP files. Max 5 MB each.

return_request.handoff_message: The salon has 7 days to decide. We will notify you by email.

success.submitted: Return request submitted. The seller review starts now and the timeline is already available.

errors.comment_too_long: Your note can contain up to 500 characters.
errors.photo_required: Add at least one supporting photo.
errors.photo_size: Each file must be smaller than 5 MB.
errors.photo_type: Only JPG, PNG and WEBP files are supported.
errors.generic: We could not submit the return request. Try again in a moment.

hero.title: Your request is in the decision queue.
hero.description: Order {orderId} is now visible to the salon and support. The next steps stay transparent for every actor.

timeline.title: Return lifecycle
timeline.description: Status uses semantic state colors and never relies on color only.

submitted.title: Request recorded
submitted.body: We stored your reason, attachments and note and notified the salon.

vendor_review.title: Salon reviews the request
vendor_review.body: The salon has up to 7 days to accept, reject or request more context.

payout.title: Refund or pickup arranged
payout.body: Once approved, support monitors refund or collection details and keeps you updated by email.

handoff.title: What happens next for each actor
handoff.description: Cross-actor handoff keeps the customer, vendor and support aligned.
handoff.for_vendor_label: What happens next for the salon:
handoff.for_customer: Watch your inbox and return timeline. If more proof is needed, you can respond without restarting the flow.
handoff.for_vendor: The salon reviews the evidence, records a decision and confirms pickup or refund details.
handoff.for_support: Support steps in when the case needs mediation, deadline follow-up or policy clarification.
handoff.for_platform: BonBeauty tracks SLA timing, keeps the audit trail and makes sure the outcome reaches every actor.

hero.title: Keep delivery details ready for the next order.
hero.description: Add, edit and delete addresses inside a focus-trapped panel with keyboard-safe controls and 44px targets.

empty.title: No saved addresses yet
empty.description: ES8 empty state for saved addresses.
empty.body: Save an address to speed up checkout and avoid retyping delivery details on the next order.

list.title: Saved addresses
list.description: Review delivery details, update them inline and remove outdated entries with confirmation.

errors.generic: We could not save the address. Try again.

delete.title: Delete this address?
delete.description: The address will be removed from your account after confirmation.

hero.title: You still have a few salons to review.
hero.description: Pending reviews stay grouped by order so you can complete feedback without hunting for the right booking.

empty.title: No reviews waiting
empty.description: ES7 gentle empty state for review prompts.
empty.body: You are caught up. When a new order becomes eligible for review, it will appear here.

list.title: Orders waiting for feedback
list.description: Open written reviews to finish the form and compare your published feedback.

hero.title: Manage the feedback you already sent.
hero.description: Edit tone, update rating or delete a review with confirmation and accessible mutation feedback.

empty.title: No written reviews yet
empty.description: Published reviews will appear here after submission.
empty.body: Use the reviews-to-write list when you are ready to share feedback.

list.title: My written reviews
list.description: Changes never surface raw backend errors. Each mutation reports a localized result.

errors.note_too_long: Your note can contain up to 300 characters.
errors.generic: We could not update the review. Try again.

delete.title: Delete review?
delete.description: This removes the published review from your account view after confirmation.

hero.title: Keep profile, security and privacy controls in one hub.
hero.description: Desktop uses anchored section navigation, while mobile keeps the same landmarks without overflow.

nav.title: Sections
nav.description: Jump between profile, security, notifications, payments and GDPR privacy.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update personal contact details with blur-based success feedback.

errors.generic: We could not update the profile. Try again.

security.title: Security
security.description: Use a password reset handoff instead of exposing raw auth errors in the UI.

errors.generic: We could not start the reset flow. Try again.

success.reset_email_sent: Reset email sent. Complete the password change from your inbox.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which updates should continue through the account team request intake for this release.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Capture payment support preferences without pretending unsupported backend mutations are complete.

privacy.title: GDPR privacy
privacy.description: Privacy actions are represented as intake requests until dedicated backend automation is available.
privacy.request_intake_notice: This release records the request and hands it off safely. It does not claim that export or deletion is already complete.

errors.generic: We could not record the privacy request. Try again.
